entities.name: Stone Druids
entities.description: Dominarian dwarves with earth magic who met Eladamri in the Stronghold and caused the volcano to erupt.

entities.name: Nadeen Dormet
entities.description: Sister who led the Stone Druids.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: Made a pact with the druids.

entities.name: Stronghold
entities.description: Yawgmoth's base purged by the druids.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Prevented from fleeing back to Phyrexia by the lava.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Channeled a white mana blast from the Null Moon.

entities.name: Null Moon
entities.description: Source of the white mana blast.

entities.name: Portcullis
entities.description: Guarded by Phyrexians the druids' tunnel outflanked.

entities.name: Martyrs' Tomb
entities.description: Site of a ceremony the druids attended.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion during which they met Eladamri.

events.summary: Eladamri makes a pact with the druids to defend them in exchange for use of their tunnel to outflank the Phyrexians at Portcullis.
events.quote: Eladamri made a pact with them to defend them

events.summary: The druids cause the volcano to erupt, engulfing the Stronghold in lava and preventing Yawgmoth's escape.
events.quote: The druids successfully caused the volcano to erupt

events.summary: The dwarves are shielded from Yawgmoth by Weatherlight's white mana blast from the Null Moon.
events.quote: the dwarves were shielded by the white mana blast Weatherlight channeled from the Null Moon
